name: "The Insane One" Justin Sane
caption: A cruiserweight who opened the promotion's own first house show and lost to Anton Strong.

tenures.source: Opened the promotion's own 4 June 1999 house show and lost to "The Man from the Alpes" Anton Strong by pinfall (Alpes Bomb belly-to-belly suplex, 1:04).

name: "The Man from the Alpes" Anton Strong
caption: A seven-foot, 450-pound Austrian wrestler who won the promotion's own opening match.

tenures.source: Defeated Justin Sane by pinfall with his own Alpes Bomb belly-to-belly suplex on the promotion's own 4 June 1999 house show, 1:04.

name: "The Future of Wrestling" "Dynomite" Derek Sweger
caption: A high-flying wrestler who submitted Billy B. Hayes with the Sweger Scream, his own Texas Cloverleaf.

tenures.source: Defeated Billy B. Hayes by submission with the Sweger Scream, a Texas Cloverleaf, on the promotion's own 4 June 1999 house show, 14:56.

name: Billy B. Hayes
caption: A 278-pound wrestler with a perfect record coming in who lost his first fall to Derek Sweger.

tenures.source: Lost to "Dynomite" Derek Sweger by submission to the Sweger Scream on the promotion's own 4 June 1999 house show, 14:56.

name: TeRrOr
caption: A hardcore brawler who beat Vincent Crow in a chair-strewn squash, drinking a fan's stolen beer mid-match.

tenures.source: Defeated Vincent Crow by pinfall on the promotion's own 4 June 1999 house show, 29:58, in a hardcore-style match built around a steel chair.

Name collision only: a same-named entity in another wing (war-1995-terror); no shared operator, chronology or storyline evidence in this wing's documents.

name: Vincent Crow
caption: A wrestler squashed by TeRrOr in a one-sided hardcore brawl.

tenures.source: Lost to TeRrOr by pinfall on the promotion's own 4 June 1999 house show, 29:58.

name: Cadaver
caption: A wrestler who traded a close, hard-fought bout with "Icon" Ron Elliot before losing by knockout.

tenures.source: Lost to "Icon" Ron Elliot by knockout (a double leg powerbomb into the ICONoclast sleeper) on the promotion's own 4 June 1999 house show, 14:39.

name: "Icon" Ron Elliot
caption: A wrestler who won a close match with a double leg powerbomb into his own ICONoclast sleeper finisher.

tenures.source: Defeated Cadaver by knockout with a double leg powerbomb into the ICONoclast sleeper on the promotion's own 4 June 1999 house show, 14:39.

name: The Y-KiKi KiD
caption: A 150-pound speedster who wore down and pinned the much larger Al "The Knife" Hoolibay.

tenures.source: Defeated Al "The Knife" Hoolibay by pinfall on the promotion's own 4 June 1999 house show, 7:23.

name: Al "The Knife" Hoolibay
caption: A big man worn down and pinned by the much smaller Y-KiKi KiD.

tenures.source: Lost to The Y-KiKi KiD by pinfall on the promotion's own 4 June 1999 house show, 7:23.

name: "Little Nasty" Allen Reynolds
caption: A wrestler thoroughly outclassed by "Playboy" George in a one-sided loss.

tenures.source: Lost to "Playboy" George by pinfall on the promotion's own 4 June 1999 house show, 10:11.

name: "Playboy" George
caption: A wrestler managed by Nick Merchant who outclassed Allen Reynolds, finishing with a top-rope frog splash.

tenures.source: Defeated "Little Nasty" Allen Reynolds by pinfall with a top-rope frog splash on the promotion's own 4 June 1999 house show, 10:11, managed by Nick Merchant.

name: "The X-TREME Superstar" Zach Ryan
caption: A hardcore-style wrestler who turned his opponent's own trash can of weapons against him to win.

tenures.source: Defeated "Swing Man" Chris Boehanan by pinfall with a tombstone piledriver onto a heap of steel chairs on the promotion's own 4 June 1999 house show, 16:34, in a weapons-strewn brawl.

name: "Swing Man" Chris Boehanan
caption: A wrestler who brought a trash can of weapons to the ring, only to have them turned against him.

tenures.source: Lost to "The X-TREME Superstar" Zach Ryan by pinfall on the promotion's own 4 June 1999 house show, 16:34.

name: "Ravenous" Ryan Jacobs
caption: A local hometown favorite who won the promotion's own main event with a moonsault guillotine legdrop.

tenures.source: Defeated "The Evil" angrysalad by pinfall with a moonsault guillotine legdrop in the promotion's own main event, 4 June 1999 house show, 42:59.

name: "The Evil" angrysalad
caption: A high-flying wrestler who took the promotion's own main event to its full time limit before losing.

tenures.source: Lost to "Ravenous" Ryan Jacobs by pinfall in the promotion's own main event, 4 June 1999 house show, 42:59.

name: Nick Merchant
caption: A manager who cornered "Playboy" George to a win over Allen Reynolds.

tenures.source: Cornered "Playboy" George to a pinfall win over "Little Nasty" Allen Reynolds on the promotion's own 4 June 1999 house show.

name: Jacob "Timebomb" Brown
caption: The promotion's own founder and owner, an embittered former star of larger federations who built the promotion's own arena himself to give unknown wrestlers a fair shot.

tenures.source: The promotion's own founding charter names him as the founder and owner who built the promotion's own arena; credited again in the sign-off of the promotion's own 4 June 1999 house-show report.
